## Medicine effects and recipes The Wasteland Medicine chapters list the current recipes and implemented effects. Field remedies and chemical mixtures may work differently; check the entry for the form you are making.
## Addiction Some performance chems can cause dependency. Repeated use can lead to withdrawal after the chem wears off. Follow the effects and cautions listed with each recipe.
## Mixing hazards Keep clean and dirty stimpak serum apart. Mixing them contaminates the clean serum. Mixing healing powder or healing poultice with stimpak or super stimpak serum creates black goo instead of a combined medicine.
## Fixer Fixer suppresses chem addiction effects. Its production recipe is in Performance chems.
